# `bs edit`

- **Usage:** `bs edit [FLAGS] <ID>`

Edit a bit via your editor, or replace its body/metadata noninteractively

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`**

## Flags
- **`--file <FILE>`** — Replace the body from a file (not frontmatter)
- **`--stdin`**
- **`--title <TITLE>`**
- **`--tags <TAGS>`** — Replace tags with a comma-separated list
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
